skill.name: Dynamic Content Loading with Layout Stability
skill.description: Prevent cumulative layout shift (CLS) when dynamically inserting new content by selecting and implementing one of three strategies: fixed-size containers/carousels, user-initiated loading with prefetch, or offscreen loading with user notice. Ensures visual stability and responsive interaction during content updates.
skill.skill_body:
When adding content dynamically (e.g., loading more products, updating live feeds), apply one of these approaches: (1) Replace old content with new content within a fixed-size container or carousel, disabling controls until transition completes; (2) Have the user initiate the load via a button (e.g., 'Load more'), prefetching content to show immediately; or (3) Load content offscreen and overlay a notice (e.g., 'Scroll to top' button). Ensure layout shifts do not occur unexpectedly and CLS remains below threshold.

## Objective

Load new content dynamically without causing unexpected layout shifts or degrading user interaction responsiveness
## Applicable Signals

- User scrolls to end of list
- User clicks 'Load more' or 'Refresh' button
- New content is ready to be inserted
- Live feed update event fires

## Contraindications

- Content is static or pre-rendered
- Layout is already fixed and cannot shift
- No dynamic insertion is required
- User has not initiated or consented to content load

## Intervention Moves

- Select fixed-size container/carousel strategy when old content must be replaced with new content in same viewport area
- Select user-initiated loading strategy when user should control when new content appears
- Select offscreen loading strategy when new content should not disrupt current viewport

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Choose loading strategy', 'detail': 'Select one of three approaches: (A) fixed-size container/carousel with content replacement, (B) user-initiated load with prefetch, or (C) offscreen load with overlay notice'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Prepare container or trigger', 'detail': 'If using fixed-size container, ensure dimensions are set. If user-initiated, create button and prefetch content. If offscreen, prepare overlay notice.'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Disable interactive elements', 'detail': 'Disable links and controls during content transition to prevent accidental interaction'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Insert or transition content', 'detail': 'Replace old content with new content, or load offscreen and show notice to user'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Re-enable interactive elements', 'detail': 'After transition completes, re-enable links and controls'}
- {'step': 6, 'action': 'Verify layout stability', 'detail': 'Confirm no unexpected layout shift occurred and CLS metric remains below threshold'}

## Constraints

- Disable links and controls until transition completes to prevent accidental clicks
- Layout shifts within 500 milliseconds of user input are not counted toward CLS
- Content must be prefetched before user interaction when using user-initiated loading strategy

## Cautions

- Accidental clicks during transition can degrade user experience; disable controls until transition completes
- Prefetching must occur before user interaction to ensure immediate display and avoid perceived delay
- Offscreen loading with overlay notice may require user action to view new content; ensure notice is clear and accessible

## Output Contract

- New content appears without visual shift
- CLS metric remains below threshold
- User interaction remains responsive after transition completes
- No layout reflow occurs outside the designated container or transition window

## Example Executions

### Example 1

- Input: User clicks 'Load more' button on product list
- Output: New products load within fixed-size container; old products removed after transition; CLS does not increase
- Notes: User-initiated load with prefetch ensures immediate display and no surprise shift

### Example 2

- Input: Live feed updates with new posts
- Output: New posts load offscreen; 'Scroll to top' notice appears; user can choose to view new content
- Notes: Offscreen loading prevents unexpected layout shift; user controls when to view new content
